New row anchors the whitespace-safety gotcha for `contains(split(col, ','), 'web')`: '"`contains(split(col, ','), 'web')` is whitespace-safe for tag-membership tests." → **FALSE — exact array-element match.** `split('mobile, web, api', ',')` returns `ARRAY['mobile', ' web', ' api']` (note the leading spaces), so `contains(..., 'web')` returns **`FALSE`** because `' web'` != `'web'`. Fix by either splitting on the literal `', '` (`split(col, ', ')`) when the delimiter is consistent, or by trimming each element after the split: `contains(transform(split(col, ','), x -> trim(x)), 'web')`.
